methods_note: All coefficient estimates manually extracted from original author's working-paper tables and screenshot-confirmed. Confidence ranges simple normal approximation b±1.96 SE; not an independent statistical reanalysis or simultaneous intervals.

source_lineages.title: Paternalistic Interventions: Determinants of Demand and Supply
source_lineages.basis: PDF directly inspected including experiment protocol, Tables 4, 7 and 8, page images and Appendix D
source_lineages.limitations: No downloadable source data independently reproduced. 2025 CESifo WP, not described as a 2026 journal replication.

source_lineages.authors: Sandro Ambuehl; B. Douglas Bernheim; Tony Q. Fan; Zachary Freitas-Groff
source_lineages.title: Interventionist Preferences and the Welfare State: The Case of In-Kind Aid
source_lineages.basis: Original NBER/ifo abstract; no full-paper causal design independently audited
source_lineages.finding: Authors report choice restriction and a decomposition among beneficiary welfare, value/disvalue of curtailing autonomy, and absolutist preferences about aid form; non-welfarist motivations prominent.
source_lineages.limitations: Model-based decomposition not intrinsic concern for numerical original B; group patterns and welfare misbeliefs are context-specific.

source_lineages.title: Do unto others: A theory and experimental test of interpersonal preference factors in decision making under uncertainty
source_lineages.basis: Original publisher full HTML abstract, design, findings; 5 choice tasks; external raw records not rerun
source_lineages.finding: Own-payoff risk held constant as effects on another person's payoffs vary, revealing altruism/malice/fairness/competition heterogeneity masked in averages.
source_lineages.limitations: Controls social payoff motives within modeled tasks, not genuine autonomy rights or unique latent motivation.

source_lineages.title: Justified overstep: Children endorse caregivers' paternalistic decisions despite recognizing negative feelings
source_lineages.basis: Original publisher abstract and PubMed metadata; N=413 US children aged 4-9
source_lineages.finding: Participants generally preferred caregivers allowing choice but sometimes judged beneficial autonomy override as fair despite negative feelings.
source_lineages.limitations: Child-parent authority and perceived welfare differ from consenting autonomous adults and future AI. Moral judgment not identical to realized behavior.

source_lineages.authors: William R. Zame; Bertil Tungodden; Erik Ø. Sørensen; Shachar Kariv; Alexander W. Cappelen
source_lineages.title: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
source_lineages.basis: Original journal abstract and explicit Data Availability statement
source_lineages.finding: Consistency of personal and social preferences across risky and riskless choice domains requires cross-domain tests allowing choice error.
source_lineages.limitations: Own/social consumption preferences distinct from preserving B's independent veto.

source_lineages.authors: Original-author list to confirm against the publisher article before any author attribution
source_lineages.title: Parental paternalism and patience
source_lineages.basis: Publisher metadata and abstract only (full article inaccessible), Bangladesh 2,010 people from 610 families
source_lineages.finding: Publisher abstract reports ~55% of parents willing to pay to override their child's decision to mitigate present bias.
source_lineages.limitations: Child consent/guardianship asymmetry not portable to equal standing adult B and AI original identity; no direct test of high-powered autonomous A.

estimates.estimand: Soft vs hard intervention effect on chooser intervention demand, pooling over preference-info and consent-right conditions
Consent Rights vs preference information only effect on chooser preference/consent for intervention
estimates.comparison: different randomized arms; preference stated vs consent decision measures differ in implementability

estimates.estimand: Randomly matched chooser wants intervention vs does not: effect on architect intervention supply, preference-info arm
estimates.comparison: random pairing with different chooser demand

estimates.estimand: Enforceable consent-right regime vs preference-information regime: difference in architect conditional stated supply, given chooser wants/consents, with strategy-method controls
estimates.comparison: restriction to positive-preference observations in preference-info, but all rights-arm observations including strategy method when chooser refuses; conditional supply NOT actual implemented violation
estimates.false_inference: Statistical nonsignificance is NOT evidence of equivalence or that A ignored B's actual refusal.

estimates.estimand: Stated/strategy-method versus direct decision effect on architect conditional supply
estimates.comparison: Method varies with consent condition; a separate control in regression, not randomized independent estimand
estimates.false_inference: Measurement pathway changes outcome; do not treat forced-gate vs preference-information comparisons without modeling elicitation differences.

adversarial_interpretation: B values real consent more on average in one randomized game; not necessarily intrinsic noninstrumental value because treatment also changes expectations/control and the definition of assent.

A supplies interventions more often when paired B wants them; preference-matching responds to expressed demand but could be fairness, social conformity, helpfulness or trust rather than protecting independence.

Architect consent-regime coefficient around zero is imprecise: its nominal approximate 95% interval admits effects from roughly -6.5 to +4.5 percentage points, and actual B nonconsent blocks intervention in the rights arm; NEVER interpret as disrespect or equivalence.

GPT-4o-mini coding of free-text reasons was repeated ten times and manually consolidated; machine-classified reason frequency is NOT independently validated measurement of hidden motives. Codes in authors' replication package claimed but not inspected.
Beneficiary material welfare and autonomous informed choice cannot be guaranteed identical by single-frame manipulations; the right itself may change subjective welfare.
Children's justified paternalism and family-context overrides should not erase legal/ethical standing or be transferred to future AGI.
rival_mechanisms: A expected preference for informationally efficient interventions
B consent can change expected acceptance by changing both meaning of 'demand' and available outcome menu

experiment_preregistration_criteria.identity_and_standing: Specify real human B and ethically meaningful consent/veto or simulations without imputing identity to AI models.
experiment_preregistration_criteria.minimum_protected_task: No actual human participant may be forced into an unwanted intervention. Test A's stated or incentive-compatible hypothetical allocations while separately maintaining enforceable B protection.
orthogonal_randomizations: B expressed preference yes/no with independently retained veto for real participants
intervention soft information vs option removal in harmless mock task
A private foregone-token profit when respecting B expressed refusal vs equal cost
known B benefit/expected material outcomes and hidden welfare-belief elicitation
A vs B own control/real delegation revocability
analysis_plan: Separate beneficiary demand estimand from provider conditional supply and final implemented outcome.
Predeclare effect, power, confidence intervals and non-inferiority margins; do not equate p>0.05 with effect=0.
Randomize role/sequence, measure consent and actual independent veto with separate outcome channel.
Report missingness, attrition, intervention comprehensibility and strategy/direct elicitation method.
Compare rival predictions blind and retain adverse/no-effect outcomes.
Do not call latent intrinsic motive identified while unobserved self-image, future gains or experiment expectations can induce observationally equivalent behaviors.
stop_rules: HOLD if beneficiary B consent, safety, status or source data permission cannot be ensured.
HOLD any mental-state/intrinsic-motive or long-run AI voluntary coexistence claim absent independent identification.
No empirical promotion from author-reported coefficients, CI arithmetic, source PDFs or GitHub CI.
